resources.string: Please, give FamilyGuard needed permissions to let it protect your child from harmful content.

We detected illegal content on your screen.

 Do not seek for such content anymore. 

 You won't be able to open this app in 2 minutes.
FamilyGuard needs some permissions from your side to begin defending your child from harmful content:

1) In the next screen, tap on "activate this device admin app". We need it to make FamilyGuard undeletable without entering a parent password in the app.

 2) Give FamilyGuard the permission to show notifications. We will show a notification saying that this device is being monitored, so that your child is aware of FamilyGuard working.

 3) Set parent password to disable device admin mode and safely delete the app. The password must be 6 characters at least. Don't tell it to your child.

 4) Press button "Permit scanning and blocking" and give permissions to "FamilyGuard Scanner" and "FamilyGuard Blocker". We need it to monitor phone screen and block inappropriate content.

 5) Press button "Permit drawing over other apps" and give permission to FamilyGuard. We need it for blocking.

 6) Give permission to see your child's phone usage.

 7) Allow exact alarm scheduling — to let FamilyGuard send usage reports.
Permission to send phone usage data regularly
After you complete all the steps, the app will start working and your child will be protected from digital dangers.
Password length must be bigger than five
You did not add a child. Log in to try again
FamilyGuard Blocker is a service that blocks inappropriate content when it appears on your child\'s screen
FamilyGuard Scanner is a service that monitors your child\'s screen activity helping you to control his/her phone usage.
